notes.title: Soundtrack all but ready
notes.notes:
Hey!

We've finally got the soundtrack pretty much finished up and to celebrate our new Greenlight campaign for Impossible caves, we're giving away a free copy for eveyone who supports us :)

Head over to: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/stats/684065170

and cast your vote, then fire us an email and we'll send you a link to the extended soundtrack Mp3.

Rock n Roll!

Thanks
Kevin and Jilly

notes.title: V.1.0.1 - Full Screen & Steam Trading Cards
notes.notes:
Firstly, 

A massive thank you to everyone who's been playing and supporting us, you folks are awesome!

We've just posted a small update to include full screen support for both Mac and Windows. 

Steam Trading Cards, Badges and custom emoji's are now live and ready to be collected :)

We're continuing to work on the game and all feedback is super welcomed and please don't be shy in leaving us comments in the Hub and any reviews would really help us out.

Speak soon!
Kevin & Jilly
